messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — I'm drafting a short "Field Snack Sheet" (one pager) for enterprise conversations that covers security highlights, SLA talking points, and deploy-mode guidance. Need: a headline that sells trust + cost predictability, 2 quick benchmark callouts, recommended CTA, and a micro routing map for inbound leads. Can you drop quick inputs here?

Oliver Park: Love the snack-sheet idea. For CTA, recommend: 'Request a Dedicated Capacity Trial' for Tier 1 accounts, and 'Start a Hosted Pilot' for PLG leads. Keep CTAs clear and two-tier.

Samir Patel: For benchmark callouts — suggest we call out median p95 latency (prod configs) and token cost delta vs naive self-hosting. e.g., "~50ms p95 for short chats" and "40–60% lower per-token cost vs baseline" — keep numbers rounded and say 'typical' not guaranteed. Also add a single-line about caching + batching impact.

Rhea Gomez: For security blurb: short, tight line: "Private deployment options (VPC/on‑prem) + KMS/HSM integrations and audit logging for regulated workloads." Call out compliance posture generically (SOC2, enterprise audit-friendly) — don't claim FedRAMP unless we have approval.

Maya Chen: Good — for the routing map, I want something field-friendly: if prospect mentions 'SLA' or 'HIPAA' or 'on‑prem', route to AE > Solutions SE. Otherwise if they start with 'trial' or 'quick POC', route to Growth SDR. Can someone draft the exact rules?

Oliver Park: Quick draft rule set:```json
{
  "inbound_signal": "keywords",
  "high_touch": ["SLA","HIPAA","on-prem","VPC","audit","SOC2"],
  "route_to": {
    "high_touch": "AE + Solutions SE",
    "pilot": "Growth SDR",
    "self_serve": "Marketing nurture"
  }
}
```

Samir Patel: Webinar tie-in: run a 30-min 'Deploy Mode Decision Lab' — 12-min framework, 8-min live demo (dedicated vs hosted), 10-min Q&A. Use snack-sheet as the webinar handout. Promote to mid-market/enterprise lists; require registration with a product‑usecase dropdown to help routing.

Rhea Gomez: Messaging suggestions for headers: "Predictable Inference for Regulated Production" or "Choose the Right Deployment: Security, Cost, SLA" — prefer shorter. Also add a one-sentence opener for SEs to read aloud: "Redwood Inference gives you consistent latency, clear SLA options, and private deployment choices so you can run LLMs in regulated environments without building the whole stack."

Maya Chen: OK I'm going to stitch these into a one-pager. Next steps: Oliver to finalize CTA copy + routing rules; Samir to provide final benchmark phrasing and cite the internal perf doc link; Rhea to sign off on the security line. Can we aim for the draft by EOD tomorrow?

Oliver Park: On it. I'll also add the inbound tagging values we'll need in SFDC. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll pull the benchmark numbers from the 2025 perf run and post a short blurb + source link here.

Rhea Gomez: I'll confirm compliance wording with trust & security tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Reminder — 30m sync scheduled in #calendar for 2025-03-02 10:00 AM.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — will post the first draft in this thread and attach the snack-sheet PDF. :pray:
